circuitpython_stdout_note: CircuitPython 10.3.0's own answer, at the same ceiling this port ships (64). It diverges from `stdout` only in the three biquad-filtered checksums -- lead, bend and bass -- and only because of the deliberate biquad deviations recorded in docs/upstream-diff.md, 'The biquads were Q15, so they could not go low'. The five other lines are identical. EXPLAINED and tracked as audioif#77: on those same three lines the CPython twin and desktop MicroPython also disagree with EACH OTHER, because the deviation is applied on one target only: synthio_biquad_filter_sample() (the single-sample entry point 10.3.0's filter chain calls) does hand-written Q15 over cp_a1..cp_b2, while its plural sibling and the whole CPython twin go through audioif_biquad_process(). Measured 2026-09-09.
